accountTypes :: Map.Map String String
accountTypes = Map.fromList
  [ ("AccountsPayable", "liability")
  , ("AccountsReceivable", "asset")
  , ("AccruedExpenses", "liability")
  , ("AccumulatedDepreciation", "liability")
  , ("Cash", "asset")
  , ("ConsumptionTaxReceived", "liability")
  , ("DepositsReceived", "liability")
  , ("Depreciation", "expense")
  , ("InterestExpense", "expense")
  , ("Purchases", "expense")
  , ("Sales", "revenue")
  , ("WageExpenditure", "expense")
  ]

accounts :: [String]
accounts = Map.keys accountTypes

computeDebitsCredits :: [MinTx] -> (Map.Map String Int, Map.Map String Int)
computeDebitsCredits postings = foldr (\x (d, c) -> 
        let b = _hatBase x
            acct = show (getAccountTitle b)
            amt = truncate (toDecimal (_val x)) :: Int
        in if whichSide b == Debit then 
             (Map.insertWith (+) acct amt d, c)
           else 
             (d, Map.insertWith (+) acct amt c)
        ) (Map.empty, Map.empty) postings

main :: IO ()
main = do
  let (debitsMap, creditsMap) = computeDebitsCredits (toList journal)
  let getDebitSum acct = Map.findWithDefault 0 acct debitsMap
  let getCreditSum acct = Map.findWithDefault 0 acct creditsMap
  let getBalance acct = let t = Map.findWithDefault "" acct accountTypes in
        case t of
          "asset" -> getDebitSum acct - getCreditSum acct
          "liability" -> getCreditSum acct - getDebitSum acct
          "expense" -> getDebitSum acct - getCreditSum acct
          "revenue" -> getCreditSum acct - getDebitSum acct

  let ledgerMetrics = concatMap (\acct -> 
        [ ("ledger." ++ acct ++ ".debits", getDebitSum acct)
        , ("ledger." ++ acct ++ ".credits", getCreditSum acct)
        , ("ledger." ++ acct ++ ".balance", getBalance acct)
        ]) accounts

  let trialMetrics = map (\acct -> ("trial_balance." ++ acct, getBalance acct)) accounts

  let total_assets = getBalance "Cash" + getBalance "AccountsReceivable"
  let total_liabilities = sum (map getBalance ["AccountsPayable", "AccruedExpenses", "AccumulatedDepreciation", "ConsumptionTaxReceived", "DepositsReceived"])
  let total_revenue = getBalance "Sales"
  let total_expenses = getBalance "Purchases" + getBalance "Depreciation" + getBalance "InterestExpense" + getBalance "WageExpenditure"
  let net_income = total_revenue - total_expenses
  let balance_check = total_assets - total_liabilities - net_income

  let financialMetrics =
        [ ("financial_statements.total_assets", total_assets)
        , ("financial_statements.total_liabilities", total_liabilities)
        , ("financial_statements.opening_equity", 0)
        , ("financial_statements.total_equity", 0)
        , ("financial_statements.total_revenue", total_revenue)
        , ("financial_statements.total_expenses", total_expenses)
        , ("financial_statements.net_income", net_income)
        , ("financial_statements.balance_check", balance_check)
        ]

  let derivedJVal = jFlatNum $ concatMap (\(k, v) -> [(k, fromIntegral v)]) $ ledgerMetrics ++ trialMetrics ++ financialMetrics
  emitObject [ ("journal", JournalComp journal), ("derived", RawComp derivedJVal) ]

      cre = sum $ map (truncate . toDecimal . _val)

-- Compute ledger summaries from postings
postings :: [Alg MoneyDecimal MinBase]
postings = toList journal

-- For an account, get debits (only if side is Debit) and credits (only if side is Credit)
computeAccountSummary :: AccountTitles -> (Int, Int)
computeAccountSummary account = (debits, credits)
  where
    accountPostings = Prelude.filter ((== account) . getAccountTitle . _hatBase) postings
    debits = sum $ map (\x -> if whichSide (_hatBase x) == Debit then truncate (toDecimal (_val x)) else 0) accountPostings
    credits = sum $ map (\x -> if whichSide (_hatBase x) == Credit then truncate (toDecimal (_val x)) else 0) accountPostings

-- Get the balance = debits - credits
computeBalance :: AccountTitles -> Int
computeBalance account = fst (computeAccountSummary account) - snd (computeAccountSummary account)

-- Compute for each required account
getDebit :: AccountTitles -> Int
getDebit account = fst (computeAccountSummary account)

getCredit :: AccountTitles -> Int
getCredit account = snd (computeAccountSummary account)

-- Compute financial statements
assetAccounts = [AccountsReceivable, Cash]
liabilityAccounts = [AccountsPayable, AccruedExpenses, AccumulatedDepreciation, ConsumptionTaxReceived, DepositsReceived]
revenueAccounts = [Sales]
expenseAccounts = [Depreciation, InterestExpense, Purchases, WageExpenditure]

totalAssets = sum $ map (\acct -> getDebit acct - getCredit acct) assetAccounts
totalLiabilities = sum $ map (\acct -> getCredit acct - getDebit acct) liabilityAccounts
totalRevenue = sum $ map (\acct -> getCredit acct - getDebit acct) revenueAccounts
totalExpenses = sum $ map (\acct -> getDebit acct - getCredit acct) expenseAccounts
netIncome = totalRevenue - totalExpenses
totalEquity = totalAssets - totalLiabilities
balanceCheck = totalAssets - totalLiabilities - netIncome

-- Compute ledger summaries from postings
postings :: [Alg MoneyDecimal MinBase]
postings = toList journal

-- For an account, get debits (only if side is Debit) and credits (only if side is Credit)
computeAccountSummary :: AccountTitles -> (Int, Int)
computeAccountSummary account = (debits, credits)
  where
    accountPostings = Prelude.filter ((== account) . getAccountTitle . _hatBase) postings
    debits = sum $ map (\x -> if whichSide (_hatBase x) == Debit then truncate (toDecimal (_val x)) else 0) accountPostings
    credits = sum $ map (\x -> if whichSide (_hatBase x) == Credit then truncate (toDecimal (_val x)) else 0) accountPostings

-- Get the balance = debits - credits
computeBalance :: AccountTitles -> Int
computeBalance account = fst (computeAccountSummary account) - snd (computeAccountSummary account)

-- Compute for each required account
getDebit :: AccountTitles -> Int
getDebit account = fst (computeAccountSummary account)

getCredit :: AccountTitles -> Int
getCredit account = snd (computeAccountSummary account)

-- Compute financial statements
assetAccounts = [AccountsReceivable, Cash]
liabilityAccounts = [AccountsPayable, AccruedExpenses, AccumulatedDepreciation, ConsumptionTaxReceived, DepositsReceived]
revenueAccounts = [Sales]
expenseAccounts = [Depreciation, InterestExpense, Purchases, WageExpenditure]

totalAssets = sum $ map (\acct -> getDebit acct - getCredit acct) assetAccounts
totalLiabilities = sum $ map (\acct -> getCredit acct - getDebit acct) liabilityAccounts
totalRevenue = sum $ map (\acct -> getCredit acct - getDebit acct) revenueAccounts
totalExpenses = sum $ map (\acct -> getDebit acct - getCredit acct) expenseAccounts
netIncome = totalRevenue - totalExpenses
totalEquity = totalAssets - totalLiabilities
balanceCheck = totalAssets - totalLiabilities - netIncome

type MinBase = HatBase AccountTitles

ledgerAccounts = [AccountsPayable, AccountsReceivable, AccruedExpenses, AccumulatedDepreciation, Cash, ConsumptionTaxReceived, DepositsReceived, Depreciation, InterestExpense, Purchases, Sales, WageExpenditure]

getTotalDebit :: AccountTitles -> Int
getTotalDebit acc = let
    postings = filter (\x -> getAccountTitle (_hatBase x) == acc) (toList journalTx)
    debits = map (toDecimal . _val) (filter (\x -> whichSide (_hatBase x) == Debit) postings)
    in truncate (sum debits)

getTotalCredit :: AccountTitles -> Int
getTotalCredit acc = let
    postings = filter (\x -> getAccountTitle (_hatBase x) == acc) (toList journalTx)
    credits = map (toDecimal . _val) (filter (\x -> whichSide (_hatBase x) == Credit) postings)
    in truncate (sum credits)

getBalance :: AccountTitles -> Int
getBalance acc = getTotalDebit acc - getTotalCredit acc

getTrialBalance :: AccountTitles -> Int
getTrialBalance acc = getBalance acc

getTotalRevenue :: Int
getTotalRevenue = getTotalCredit Sales

getTotalExpenses :: Int
getTotalExpenses = getTotalDebit Depreciation + getTotalDebit InterestExpense + getTotalDebit Purchases + getTotalDebit WageExpenditure

getTotalAssets :: Int
getTotalAssets = getBalance Cash + getBalance AccountsReceivable

getTotalLiabilities :: Int
getTotalLiabilities = 
    getBalance AccountsPayable +
    getBalance AccruedExpenses +
    getBalance AccumulatedDepreciation +
    getBalance ConsumptionTaxReceived +
    getBalance DepositsReceived

getOpeningEquity = 0

getTotalEquity :: Int
getTotalEquity = getTotalAssets - getTotalLiabilities

getNetIncome :: Int
getNetIncome = getTotalRevenue - getTotalExpenses

-- Compute debits and credits per account
computeDebitCredit :: [Alg MoneyDecimal MinBase] -> AccountTitles -> (Int, Int)
computeDebitCredit postings accTitle = 
  let 
    postingsForAcc = Prelude.filter (\x -> getAccountTitle (_hatBase x) == accTitle) postings
    (debits, credits) = foldr (\post (d,c) -> if whichSide (_hatBase post) == Debit
                                       then (d + fromIntegral (truncate (toDecimal (_val post))), c)
                                       else (d, c + fromIntegral (truncate (toDecimal (_val post))))) (0,0) postingsForAcc
  in (debits, credits)

-- Compute balance based on account type
computeBalance :: AccountTitles -> (Int, Int) -> Int
computeBalance acc (debits, credits) =
  case Map.lookup acc accountTypesMap of
    Just "asset" -> debits - credits
    Just "expense" -> debits - credits
    Just "liability" -> credits - debits
    Just "revenue" -> credits - debits
    _ -> 0 -- should not happen

-- Get the list of all accounts we need to report for ledger
requiredAccounts :: [AccountTitles]
requiredAccounts = [AccountsPayable, AccountsReceivable, AccruedExpenses, AccumulatedDepreciation, Cash,
                   ConsumptionTaxReceived, DepositsReceived, Depreciation, InterestExpense, Purchases, Sales,
                   WageExpenditure]

-- Get the list of asset, liability, and expense/revenue accounts for financials
assetAccounts, liabilityAccounts, expenseAccounts, revenueAccounts :: [AccountTitles]
assetAccounts = [Cash, AccountsReceivable]
liabilityAccounts = [AccountsPayable, AccruedExpenses, AccumulatedDepreciation, ConsumptionTaxReceived, DepositsReceived]
expenseAccounts = [Depreciation, InterestExpense, Purchases, WageExpenditure]
revenueAccounts = [Sales]

-- Compute total assets (sum of balance for each asset account)
totalAssets :: [Int] -> Int
totalAssets = sum

-- Compute total liabilities (sum of balance for each liability account)
totalLiabilities :: [Int] -> Int
totalLiabilities = sum

-- Compute total revenues (balance of Sales)
totalRevenue :: Int -> Int
totalRevenue bal = bal

-- Compute total expenses (sum of balance for each expense account)
totalExpenses :: [Int] -> Int
totalExpenses = sum

-- Compute net income = total_revenue - total_expenses
netIncome :: Int -> Int -> Int
netIncome rev exp = rev - exp

-- Compute total equity = net_income (assuming opening equity = 0)
totalEquity :: Int -> Int
totalEquity net = net

-- Compute balance_check (1 if total_assets == total_liabilities + total_equity, else 0)
balanceCheck :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
balanceCheck assets liabilities equity = if assets == (liabilities + equity) then 1 else 0

-- Generate the derived map
deriveValues :: [Alg MoneyDecimal MinBase] -> [(String, Int)]
deriveValues postings = 
  let 
    -- Get debits and credits for each account
    accountsDebitCredit = [(acc, computeDebitCredit postings acc) | acc <- requiredAccounts]

    -- Compute ledger.* values
    ledgerValues = concat [ [ ("ledger." ++ show acc ++ ".debits", debits), ("ledger." ++ show acc ++ ".credits", credits), ("ledger." ++ show acc ++ ".balance", computeBalance acc (debits, credits)), ("trial_balance." ++ show acc, computeBalance acc (debits, credits)) ]
                    | (acc, (debits, credits)) <- accountsDebitCredit ]

    -- Financial statements
    assetBalances = [ computeBalance acc (debits, credits) | (acc, (debits, credits)) <- accountsDebitCredit, acc `elem` assetAccounts ]
    liabilityBalances = [ computeBalance acc (debits, credits) | (acc, (debits, credits)) <- accountsDebitCredit, acc `elem` liabilityAccounts ]
    expenseBalances = [ computeBalance acc (debits, credits) | (acc, (debits, credits)) <- accountsDebitCredit, acc `elem` expenseAccounts ]
    revenueBalances = [ computeBalance acc (debits, credits) | (acc, (debits, credits)) <- accountsDebitCredit, acc `elem` revenueAccounts ]

    totalAssetsValue = totalAssets assetBalances
    totalLiabilitiesValue = totalLiabilities liabilityBalances
    totalRevenueValue = totalRevenue (head revenueBalances) -- only one revenue account
    totalExpensesValue = totalExpenses expenseBalances
    netIncomeValue = netIncome totalRevenueValue totalExpensesValue
    totalEquityValue = totalEquity netIncomeValue
    balanceCheckValue = balanceCheck totalAssetsValue totalLiabilitiesValue totalEquityValue

    financialValues = [ 
        ("financial_statements.total_assets", totalAssetsValue),
        ("financial_statements.total_liabilities", totalLiabilitiesValue),
        ("financial_statements.opening_equity", 0),
        ("financial_statements.total_equity", totalEquityValue),
        ("financial_statements.total_revenue", totalRevenueValue),
        ("financial_statements.total_expenses", totalExpensesValue),
        ("financial_statements.net_income", netIncomeValue),
        ("financial_statements.balance_check", balanceCheckValue)
      ]
  in ledgerValues ++ financialValues

main :: IO ()
main = do
  let postings = toList journal
  let derivedMap = deriveValues postings
  emitObject
    [ ("journal", JournalComp journal)
    , ("derived", RawComp (jFlatNum $ map (\(k,v) -> (k, fromIntegral v)) derivedMap))

-- Compute debits and credits per account
computeDebitCredit :: [Alg MoneyDecimal MinBase] -> AccountTitles -> (Int, Int)
computeDebitCredit postings accTitle = 
  let 
    postingsForAcc = Prelude.filter (\x -> getAccountTitle (_hatBase x) == accTitle) postings
    (debits, credits) = foldr (\post (d,c) -> if whichSide (_hatBase post) == Debit
                                       then (d + fromIntegral (truncate (toDecimal (_val post))), c)
                                       else (d, c + fromIntegral (truncate (toDecimal (_val post))))) (0,0) postingsForAcc
  in (debits, credits)

-- Compute balance based on account type
computeBalance :: AccountTitles -> (Int, Int) -> Int
computeBalance acc (debits, credits) =
  case Map.lookup acc accountTypesMap of
    Just "asset" -> debits - credits
    Just "expense" -> debits - credits
    Just "liability" -> credits - debits
    Just "revenue" -> credits - debits
    _ -> 0 -- should not happen

netIncome :: Int -> Int -> Int
netIncome rev exp = rev - exp

-- Compute total equity = net_income (assuming opening equity = 0)
totalEquity :: Int -> Int
totalEquity net = net

-- Compute balance_check (1 if total_assets == total_liabilities + total_equity, else 0)
balanceCheck :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
balanceCheck assets liabilities equity = if assets == (liabilities + equity) then 1 else 0

-- Generate the derived map
deriveValues :: [Alg MoneyDecimal MinBase] -> [(String, Int)]
deriveValues postings = 
  let 
    -- Get debits and credits for each account
    accountsDebitCredit = [(acc, computeDebitCredit postings acc) | acc <- requiredAccounts]

    -- Compute ledger.* values
    ledgerValues = concat [ [ ("ledger." ++ show acc ++ ".debits", debits), ("ledger." ++ show acc ++ ".credits", credits), ("ledger." ++ show acc ++ ".balance", computeBalance acc (debits, credits)), ("trial_balance." ++ show acc, computeBalance acc (debits, credits)) ]
                    | (acc, (debits, credits)) <- accountsDebitCredit ]

    -- Financial statements
    assetBalances = [ computeBalance acc (debits, credits) | (acc, (debits, credits)) <- accountsDebitCredit, acc `elem` assetAccounts ]
    liabilityBalances = [ computeBalance acc (debits, credits) | (acc, (debits, credits)) <- accountsDebitCredit, acc `elem` liabilityAccounts ]
    expenseBalances = [ computeBalance acc (debits, credits) | (acc, (debits, credits)) <- accountsDebitCredit, acc `elem` expenseAccounts ]
    revenueBalances = [ computeBalance acc (debits, credits) | (acc, (debits, credits)) <- accountsDebitCredit, acc `elem` revenueAccounts ]

    totalAssetsValue = totalAssets assetBalances
    totalLiabilitiesValue = totalLiabilities liabilityBalances
    totalRevenueValue = totalRevenue (head revenueBalances) -- only one revenue account
    totalExpensesValue = totalExpenses expenseBalances
    netIncomeValue = netIncome totalRevenueValue totalExpensesValue
    totalEquityValue = totalEquity netIncomeValue
    balanceCheckValue = balanceCheck totalAssetsValue totalLiabilitiesValue totalEquityValue

    financialValues = [ 
        ("financial_statements.total_assets", totalAssetsValue),
        ("financial_statements.total_liabilities", totalLiabilitiesValue),
        ("financial_statements.opening_equity", 0),
        ("financial_statements.total_equity", totalEquityValue),
        ("financial_statements.total_revenue", totalRevenueValue),
        ("financial_statements.total_expenses", totalExpensesValue),
        ("financial_statements.net_income", netIncomeValue),
        ("financial_statements.balance_check", balanceCheckValue)
      ]
  in ledgerValues ++ financialValues

main :: IO ()
main = do
  let postings = toList journal
  let derivedMap = deriveValues postings
  emitObject
    [ ("journal", JournalComp journal)
    , ("derived", RawComp (jFlatNum $ map (\(k,v) -> (k, fromIntegral v)) derivedMap))
    ]
